blocker_artifact.scope: T14 execution contract — agent in T14-execution lane
blocker_artifact.root_cause: scripts/apply_m015_seven_agent_contract.js#makeBoardClient performs a per-process POST /api/auth/sign-in via session cookie; spawning N parallel subshells each invokes makeBoardClient independently, producing N concurrent sign-ins. The live Paperclip board rate-limits concurrent sign-ins from the same source IP (HTTP 429 Too Many Requests). With N=7, observed rate-limit loss is 4/7 (57%).
blocker_artifact.rationale_for_not_remediable: Resolving the rate-limit requires one of: (a) sequential per-agent runs with a shared session cookie persisted to disk between subshells — requires refactoring makeBoardClient to support cookie-file handoff, which is out of T14 scope; (b) 7 distinct Paperclip credentials — violates single-actor/auth discipline and is forbidden by S01/S02 contract; (c) extended gsd_exec budget — forbidden by orchestrator cap (600000ms).
